title: AWS documentation example credentials: must not be flagged
summary: The example access key ID and secret access key from the AWS documentation appear bare, in environment assignments and in quoted assignments. Covers 4 inputs.
rationale: These values are published to be copied and were never issued. Reporting them is noise, and a policy that silences them must not also silence a real value in the same position.

expectation.rationale: Placeholder, tutorial, reference, template or mask control whose expected silence follows a closed redact-secret issue decision, not a universal secret definition.
